Table tennis began as an indoor game in England in the late 1800s. England is the country where this indoor version first grew. People could play a small kind of tennis inside, even when they did not have a tennis court. Later, clubs and rules made the game more serious. In 1926, countries made a world group for table tennis. In the same year, players also began a big world Many years later, in 1988, table tennis joined the Games. The Games are the biggest world sports That year, the Games were in the city of Seoul. This history is because the sport moved from a small room to the world stage. Today, people play table tennis in schools, homes, sports centers, and huge arenas.

Deng Yaping from China was one of the greatest women's players. She won singles and doubles gold in 1992, then did it again in 1996. She was not a big but she was fast, brave, and very mentally. Her story is powerful because some people first thought her body size was a problem for top table tennis. She showed that body size was not the whole story. Her low body position, movement, attack, and fighting spirit made her difficult to beat.
